evals.name: generic-clean-up-prompt
evals.prompt: I just got Infuse for my Apple TV and pointed it at my movies folder. It looks awful — everything is named like Blade.Runner.2049.2017.UHD.BluRay.x265-RARBG.mkv with random .nfo and .jpg files everywhere. Before you do anything, build a small messy test library at /tmp/eval-0-movies/ (about 8-10 items mixing loose video files with companion poster/nfo files, one empty placeholder folder, and at least one folder already in messy release-name format). Then organize that library to whatever folder structure Infuse expects. When you're done, list what's at the top level and explain what changed.
evals.expected_output: A /tmp/eval-0-movies/ directory reorganized into per-movie 'Title (YYYY)/' folders, with a written report describing the changes.

evals.name: year-in-title-trap
evals.prompt:
Build a tiny test movie library at /tmp/eval-1-movies/ containing these loose files (you can use `touch` to create empty placeholders since we just want to test the organization, not actually have movie data):

- Blade.Runner.2049.2017.UHD.BluRay.x265-RARBG.mkv
- Blade.Runner.2049.2017.UHD.BluRay.x265-RARBG.nfo
- Blade.Runner.2049.2017.UHD.BluRay.x265-RARBG-poster.jpg
- 2001.A.Space.Odyssey.1968.2160p.UHD.BluRay.mkv
- 1917.2019.1080p.DVDSCR.x264-TOPKEK.mkv
- Citizen.Kane.1941.2160p.UHD.BluRay.mkv

Then reorganize the library into per-movie folders the way Infuse expects. Make sure 'Blade Runner 2049' ends up under its correct 2017 release year folder, not under a folder named after the title's year-like number.
evals.expected_output: A 'Blade Runner 2049 (2017)/' folder exists with all three Blade Runner files inside. '2001 A Space Odyssey (1968)/', '1917 (2019)/', 'Citizen Kane (1941)/' folders also exist.

evals.name: multi-version-and-collection
evals.prompt:
Build a small test library at /tmp/eval-2-movies/ that includes:

1. Two different rips of the same movie — Ballerina.2025.1080p.AMZN.WEB-DL-BYNDR.mkv and Ballerina.2025.2160p.iT.WEB-DL.DV.HDR-BYNDR.mkv (loose at top level, with matching .nfo for each)
2. A 'James.Bond.Collection.1962-2008/' folder containing Dr.No.1962.mkv, Goldfinger.1964.mkv, and From.Russia.with.Love.1963.mkv
3. A couple of normal loose movies — say, Dune.Part.Two.2024.1080p.WEB-DL.mkv and The.Matrix.1999.2160p.UHD.BluRay.mkv

Now organize this for Infuse. I particularly want to know how you handle the multi-version Ballerina situation and the Bond collection folder — explain your reasoning. Don't just bulldoze through; show me what decisions you're making.
evals.expected_output: Library organized with per-movie folders. Ballerina (2025) has both versions in one folder OR a clear explanation of why versions were combined/kept separate. James Bond Collection folder is preserved or flagged as a user-decision item with rationale shown.
